title: Lead AI & Value Transformation Consultant - CPG
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p class="p1"><strong>The Team:</strong> Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>The Role:</strong> As a Lead AI & Value Transformation Consultant, you will architect and drive large-scale AI and data-driven business transformation within the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) sector using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Senior and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As a master AI operator, your core mandate is to support complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their Finance and Supply-Chain ecosystems.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>The work you’ll do:</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1"><strong>Value Selling & Realization:</strong> Map how the Celonis platform accelerates and underpins the customer’s enterprise AI strategy.. Take end-to-end accountability for massive ROI targets. Craft board-level executive narratives and lead complex, multi-workstream value workshops.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Stakeholder Management:</strong> Execute C-level orchestration, cultivating powerful executive sponsorship across the C-suite. Drive lasting adoption by co-owning enterprise-wide change management and building advanced CoE operating models for total self-sufficiency.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Program Management:</strong> Steer and govern massive, cross-regional transformation programs. Guide product development by identifying next-generation industry use cases.</li> </ul> <p class="p1"><strong>The qualifications you need:</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li1"><strong>Experience:</strong> 7+ years of highly relevant experience, demonstrating ownership of multiple strategic workstreams and possessing a growing body of expert industry knowledge.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>AI & Technical & Fluency:</strong> Deep background in enterprise IT and SaaS (e.g., SAP). Master AI-fluent operator who uses AI to scale outputs and guides technical teams on complex solution design.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Builder Mentality:</strong> Thrives in ambiguity, capable of setting the strategic direction for entire account teams. Deeply committed to <em>living for customer value</em>.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Process Improvement & Value Realization:</strong> Master of value realization, setting the standard for business-critical proof points and advanced use cases.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management:</strong> Expert at orchestrating massive enterprise programs and navigating portfolio complexities. Proven ability to mobilize C-suite sponsorship. Flawless English with exceptional executive presence.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Domain & Industry:</strong> Expert knowledge in Finance/Supply Chain and deep expertise in CPG market dynamics. title: Principal Growth Manager - EMEA
description: <h2>Who Are We?</h2> <p>RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.</p> <p>We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.</p> <p>RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.</p> <h2>Role Overview</h2> <p>As Principal Growth Manager, EMEA, you will own a book of RZR's largest and most complex accounts in the region, including top-tier gaming publishers that spend at the very top of our platform. You will be the senior expert in the room: diagnosing performance, building multi-quarter growth plans, and turning data into a case that clients' leadership will act on.</p> <p>You will report to our Chief Revenue Officer and work closely with Analytics, Ad Ops, Product, and New Business. As the most senior individual contributor on the EMEA Growth team, you will also be the go-to mentor for other Growth Managers and share what works on large accounts across the team.</p> <p>This role exists now because our biggest EMEA accounts are growing fast and need a senior owner with deep DSP expertise, someone who can run them independently from day one.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Strategic Account Ownership</h3> <ul> <li>Own a book of top-tier EMEA accounts and drive net revenue growth and retention against quarterly targets.</li> <li>Build and run multi-quarter growth plans for each account, with clear revenue milestones and expansion plays across User Acquisition, Retargeting and CTV.</li> <li>Lead QBRs and strategic sessions with client leadership, and build relationships well above the day-to-day contact.</li> </ul> <h3>Performance & Insight</h3> <ul> <li>Diagnose performance shifts and run test roadmaps across creative, audience and bidding with our Analytics and Ad Ops teams.</li> <li>Translate complex technical topics such as SKAN, MMP attribution, bidding and LTV optimization into clear strategy for clients.</li> </ul> <h3>Revenue Operations</h3> <ul> <li>Own the revenue forecast for your book and be accountable for its accuracy.</li> <li>Spot churn risk early and manage it, with clear escalation paths and documentation.</li> </ul> <h3>Team Leverage</h3> <ul> <li>Mentor Growth Managers, share playbooks from large-account work, and bring EMEA market intelligence to leadership.</li> </ul> <h2>Required Skills and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>6+ years in mobile advertising or ad tech, including 5+ years client-facing in growth, account management or customer success at a DSP, ad network or programmatic platform.</li> <li>You have personally managed accounts with multi-million-dollar annual spend (ideally $1M+ per month) and grown them through a defined plan.</li> <li>Deep technical fluency in performance programmatic: bidding and auction dynamics, ROAS/LTV optimization, SKAN and MMP attribution, and creative testing.</li> <li>Strong forecasting discipline, with a track record of accurate revenue calls.</li> <li>Experience managing senior client stakeholders (VP, Head of UA and C-level).</li> <li>Fluent English; based in or able to relocate to London, with regular travel across EMEA.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to Have</h3> <ul> <li>Mobile gaming publisher experience, especially with large European studios.</li> <li>CTV or retargeting experience.</li> <li>Mentoring or informal team-lead experience.</li> <li>A second EMEA business language (German, French, Turkish or similar).</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join RZR in London?</h2> <ul> <li><strong>The biggest accounts in the region.</strong> You will hold relationships with top-tier gaming publishers, where your recommendations move millions in spend.</li> <li><strong>A senior IC track with real influence.</strong> You will be the expert other Growth Managers learn from, with no need to move into management to keep growing.</li> <li><strong>A small, senior team at a breakout moment.</strong> RZR is one of the fastest-growing DSPs in mobile, with a goal of becoming a top-3 DSP within two years.</li> <li><strong>More levers on every account.</strong> UA, Retargeting and CTV under one platform, powered by machine learning built for performance.</li> <li><strong>Upside that pays.</strong> A competitive base plus quarterly variable compensation, with accelerators for beating target.</li> </ul> <h2>RZR Behaviors</h2> <p>RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership · Move Fast · Drive for Excellence · Proactive Communication · Courage · Curiosity · Deliver Results · Manage title: Staff Backend Engineer - Operations Tech Team
description: Staff Backend Engineer - Operations Tech Team Hybrid in London, UK We’re looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join the Operations Tech team. You’ll influence the technical direction of iwoca’s in-house CRM and build parts of it yourself – the system that hundreds of staff across sales, account management, credit, and collections use to give our customers five-star service. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Operations Tech team builds the tools iwoca’s UK operations teams use every day: the CRM, and the systems behind phone calls, emails, notifications, and task management. Those tools are a competitive advantage – they help colleagues manage risk and enable the outstanding customer service that sets iwoca apart. The team works closely with the Operations Strategy team, which sets operational priorities and scopes much of the tooling. Many of its users work in the same building, and you’ll see how your changes affect the people you work with. We’re growing the team to ten engineers (including this role), two of them tech leads, and two product owners. Most of its time goes on quarterly roadmap projects, alongside a support rota, and regular small feature improvements. The role As a staff backend engineer, you’ll take whole projects end to end: work out what operations teams need, design it, build it, and look after it in production. You’ll decide with the tech leads where the CRM’s service boundaries sit and how to model each domain’s data. You’ll judge your work by what it changes for those teams and their customers. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no line management, but you’ll mentor the engineers around you. You’ll often pair with a more junior engineer, share what you know, and set the standards the team works to through design discussions and code review. You’ll learn how iwoca lends, from credit decisions to collections and financial crime. The team is adding AI to the CRM’s workflows, and you’ll have a say in where it helps. Live project examples: Migrating the monolith. Moving CRM functionality out of iwoca’s Django monolith into separate services, such as customer contact and phone calls, that deploy and scale on their own. Building customer-facing AI agents to take the load off our teams as we grow, and the infrastructure to make them reliable and trustworthy Improving our onboarding journey to so that there’s less manual work getting a customer their funds, for example using LLMs to speed up compliance checks Credit card operations. Building the CRM services that let operations teams support customers on iwoca’s business credit card. iwocaChat. Extending the Claude-powered assistant that answers operations staff questions about a customer, using data held across several systems. The requirements Essential: System design. You’ve designed large production systems and the domain models at their core, and changed their architecture while people relied on them. Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You’ve written and run backend services in it. Technical leadership. You’ve led technical decisions across a team as an individual contributor, and helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions. Operational problems. You’ve worked with non-technical colleagues to understand a problem they had, and built the system that solved it. AI leverage. You’ve built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience. Bonus: Python stack. You’ve worked with Python, Django, Celery, and PostgreSQL. Full-stack. You’ve contributed to frontend codebases, particularly in React or TypeScript. Monolith migration. You’ve moved functionality out of a large monolith into separate services, while both stayed in production. Asynchronous systems. You’ve built services that communicate through message queues such as RabbitMQ. Contact systems. You’ve worked on telephony, email, or messaging systems, such as Twilio. Models in production systems. You’ve built systems that use model outputs to make operational decisions, such as which work to prioritise. The salary We expect to pay from £100,000 to £130,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. We already sit at the start of the used journey: through Sell My Car, dealers buy cars from Carwow sellers every day. But today that car leaves our platform the moment it's bought. The dealer preps it, prices it and lists it somewhere else, and the buyer finds it somewhere else too. We want to close that loop. If every car a dealer buys can go live on Carwow in hours, priced to sell and matched to the buyers who want it, we become the place dealers source, retail and sell their used stock. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for a vertical we are fully investing in, and working day to day with design and engineering to build it. AI changes what's possible here. A dealer shouldn't have to work out what a car is worth, write the advert or chase the buyer; the product should do it for them. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that looks like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to separate real dealer value from noise. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an experienced Senior Account Executive to join our busy team. The successful candidate will work across a client portfolio including Warburtons and Nestle, therefore FMCG, Food & Drinks experience is ideal. The role is perfect for someone who is culturally connected, follows the latest trends and has a passion for storytelling. In addition, experience on clients targeting high net worth individuals would be preferrable for the luxury & travel side of the portfolio including clients such as Riverstone living and Avis First</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent client service and management</li> <li>Ability to operate within a large team, manage upwards and report into client leads.</li> <li>Delivery of projects and campaigns in line with budgets, ROI and results</li> <li>Deep media relations and press office experience</li> <li>Solid experience working with talent and influencers</li> <li>Imaginative writing skills</li> <li>Passion for producing quality work with great attention to detail</li> <li>Proficient in finance management</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understanding of FMCG, Luxury & Travel.</li> <li>Commercial Acumen</li> <li>Creative Collaboration</li> <li>Excellent Communication Skills</li> <li>Influencer & Talent Co-ordination</li> <li>Press & Social Media Awareness</li> </ul> <p><strong>Burson UK was named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026!</strong></p> <p><strong>#LI-CY1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager, Product Design (f/m/d)
description: <h2>About The Opportunity</h2> <p>We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead a team of product designers working across some of Contentful’s most foundational product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business foundations, and design systems. Contentful is the composable content platform powering how the world's leading brands create, manage, and deliver digital experiences. These teams enable our platform's evolution as we build AI native features — turning ambitious product strategy into intuitive, well-crafted experiences for the customers and partners who build on Contentful every day. You'll balance strategic design leadership with people management: coaching designers, raising the bar on craft, and ensuring design has a strong voice in how these foundational parts of the platform take shape.</p> <h2> What To Expect?</h2> <ul> <li>You'll manage designers across three product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business infrastructure, and design systems. Optimization, Application Foundations and Business Foundations. While all teams strive to deliver solutions for a holistic, unified platform, each has a distinct focus. </li> <ul> <li>Our Optimization group focuses on advancing personalization and analytics capabilities. </li> <li>Our Application Foundations group includes design systems & information architecture, as well as workflows & automation tooling, and search & discoverability. Notably, the Contentful platform is built on our open source design system, Forma 36. </li> <li>The Business Foundations group focuses on identity & access, monetization, and platform insights. </li> </ul> <li>You'll manage a team of designers you can genuinely invest in — coaching career growth, shaping how they work, and giving them real ownership over their piece of the platform.</li> <li>You'll partner directly with product and engineering leadership on strategy, not just execution to shape how Optimization, Application Foundations, and Business Foundations evolve.</li> <li>You'll help define what AI-native design leadership looks like at Contentful, at a moment when the company is actively maturing that muscle. The Contentful platform includes AI powered customer facing features, and accordingly, we progressively evolve our design tooling and ways of working to take advantage of emerging technologies. </li> <li>You can be located in or near our London hub. The product designers you manage will be located in EMEA as well, distributed across London, Dublin and our Berlin headquarters. Your manager will be US based and you will collaborate with colleagues globally. </li> <li>Some travel is expected. The organization typically has training and/or workshops located in our Berlin headquarters, approximately quarterly. </li> <li>You will be joining at a pivotal moment: Contentful's recent acquisition by Salesforce puts this team's work in front of a massive new customer base, giving you a rare chance to help shape design at a large scale. </li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You Need To Be Successful</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of product design experience, including 3+ years directly managing and developing product designers, ideally at a B2B SaaS or platform company.</li> <li>Strong track record of partnering with product and engineering leadership at the strategy level, not just translating requirements. You will influence roadmap decisions, represent design's perspective in cross-functional planning, and drive visioning initiatives. </li> <li>A strong customer-centric orientation. You ground design and product decisions in real customer insights and instill that same instinct across your team.</li> <li>A track record of design leadership that extends beyond your own team. Experience shaping and evolving the product design function’s practices within an organization. </li> <li>Maintain a high bar for design craft, with a portfolio reflecting strong interaction and visual design fundamentals. You set and uphold that same bar across your team by giving specific, actionable feedback that sharpens execution, not just strategy.</li> <li>A track record of leading design for complex, multi-team product areas. You should influence a coherent vision that translates across teams supporting a unified platform. </li> <li>Experience owning or contributing to a design system at scale; familiarity with design systems like Forma 36.</li> <li>Demonstrated success managing distributed, global teams. </li> <li>A genuine interest in AI-native product design, including shipping AI-powered customer-facing features, as well as evolving design tooling and workflows.</li> <li>Strong portfolio evidence of coaching designers' career growth. Experience facilitating promotions, skill development, and performance management. </li> <li>Comfort operating in a technically complex, enterprise/platform context. The interfaces and user flows we design operate within a headless, API first context and a mindset of ‘systems thinking’ is paramount. </li> </ul> <p>More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link: <a class="link__new-tab" href="https://www.salesforcebenefits.com/" target="_blank">https://www.salesforcebenefits.com</a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Contentful is now officially part of Salesforce.</strong></p> <h2>Unleash Your Potential</h2> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.<br><br>More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: <a href="https://www.salesforcebenefits.com" target="_blank">https://www.salesforcebenefits.com</a></p> <p><em>If you need reasonable accommodations at any point during the application or interview process, please let your Recruiter know.</em></p> <h2>Equal Opportunity Statement</h2> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.</p> <p><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal" target="_blank">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p> <p><span style="color: #3e3e3e;"><em>Please be aware of scammers who may fraudulently claim to be from Contentful. These types of fraud can occur through copycat websites, fake email addresses claiming to be from our company, or social media. We do not ask for your personal information, such as bank account numbers, identification numbers, etc., through social media or chat-based apps, nor do we request or send money to purchase business equipment. If you suspect fraud, please report it to your local authorities and contact us at <a ----- ----- </em></span><span style="color: #3e3e3e;"><em>with any information you may have.</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">By clicking “Apply for this job,” I acknowledge that I have read the “</span><a href="https://www.contentful.com/legal/privacy-and-data-protection/privacy-notice-to-candidates/" target="_blank"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Contentful’s Candidate Privacy Notice</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">” and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive - London
description: About Us Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the Role We're looking for a natural Sales person who is passionate about hospitality. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market. In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more. What You’ll Do Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate: Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about Create engaging ways to show our product Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants needs to create our own path What You’ll Need You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry: Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech A minimum of 3 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality Previous POS/ Hospitality tech sales is a strong plus You are comfortable working in English If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers . Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary Flexible time off Team events What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking to improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while preserving quality and reliability.</p> <p>You will work with kernel and platform engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and resolve performance and quality regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts under real-world workloads.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own optimization projects for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.</li> <li>Compare inference engines and recommend serving configurations suited to individual workloads.</li> <li>Diagnose model-quality and performance regressions during production rollouts.</li> <li>Improve LLM and VLM endpoint latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.</li> <li>Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo.</li> <li>Develop production model-compression workflows covering quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.</li> <li>Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving. For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture.</li> <li>Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets.</li> <li>Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead.</li> <li>Build reproducible benchmark harnesses measuring TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token. Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.</li> <li>Collaborate with GPU kernel and platform engineers to trace bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.</li> <li>Produce design documents, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Strong engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or an equivalent internal system.</li> <li>A strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks involving KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.</li> <li>Ability to quantify trade-offs among latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost.</li> <li>Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or SmoothQuant.</li> <li>Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or related inference acceleration methods.</li> <li>Experience supporting agentic workloads involving tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.</li> <li>Familiarity with CUDA or Triton; the role does not require kernel engineering to be the candidate’s primary specialization.</li> <li>Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, or KServe.</li> <li>Implementation experience with cache-aware request routing, PDD, or WideEP, including diagnosing communication bottlenecks and load imbalance.</li> <li>Familiarity with GPU communication libraries and interconnects, such as NCCL, NVLink, InfiniBand, or RoCE.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits & Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <p>Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. </p> <p>If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer
description: <h3>About the Position</h3> <p>Our goal is to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street full time while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. As an intern, you are paired with full-time employees who act as mentors, collaborating with you on real-world projects we actually need done.</p> <p>As a Software Engineering intern, you'll learn how we use OCaml (our primary development language) in our day-to-day work, and gain exposure to the libraries and tools that are foundational to our internal systems. Some teams also use Python, so depending on the project, you might do some work with Python as well.</p> <p>During the internship, you'll be closely mentored by full-time software engineers. Mentors design intern projects based on their team's current needs and are heavily invested in helping interns build maintainable, high-quality software that is intended to reach production. The projects you will work on are as varied and diverse as those full-timers work on, covering a wide range of problems, from high-performance trading systems to programming language design and everything in between.</p> <p>If you’d like to learn more, you can read about our <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/preparing-for-a-software-engineering-interview/">interview</a> and<a href="https://blog.janestreet.com/project-pairing/#fn:1"> team placement</a> processes and get a sense of what our <a href="https://blog.janestreet.com/tag/internship/">most recent intern projects</a> looked like! You can also learn more about Jane Street’s internship program <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/internships/">here</a>.</p> <h3>About You</h3> <p>If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:</p> <ul> <li>A top-notch programmer with a love for technology</li> <li>Intellectually curious, collaborative, and eager to learn</li> <li>Humble and unafraid to ask questions and admit mistakes</li> <li>Fluent in English</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Community You Will Join:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Difference You will Make:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">As a Senior Key Account Manager on the Hotels Enterprise team, you will own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of global and multinational hotel groups in your region. Your goal is to turn introductions into signed agreements then into live, healthy, growing inventory by increasing participation, bookings and revenue across Airbnb and HotelTonight. You will lead the account planning cycle with each partner, negotiate and renew commercial terms, and be the single point of contact between their executives and many Airbnb teams including Connectivity, Product, Legal and Market Management teams.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; title: Senior GRC Engineer
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the Team Come help us build the world's most trusted on-demand logistics engine for delivery! We're building a team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no-downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash's multi-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and drivers. About the Role We're hiring a Senior GRC Engineer to help take DoorDash's compliance program from something people run to something the platform runs on its own. Reporting to the Security Compliance Manager, you'll take primary ownership of how regulatory and framework change gets tracked, interpreted, and turned into real controls - one part of a broader GRC function that spans audit, policy, and risk. Day to day, that means less time updating spreadsheets and more time writing the automation, integrations, and control logic that let audit evidence collect itself. You'll also lead major external audits from start to finish and help shape the policies and control standards the rest of the program is built on.This is a hands-on role for someone who already has deep audit and assurance experience, wants to spend more time building than briefing and can move a program forward, and change how people work, without needing the title to make it happen. You're excited about this opportunity because you will… Build the regulatory and framework change-management process that keeps DoorDash ahead of new obligations, instead of reacting to them. Move manual, point-in-time compliance work onto Compliance-as-Code foundations: policy-as-code, automated control testing, and continuous evidence collection wired into CI/CD, so audit readiness holds up between audits, not just during them. Design and run agentic workflows for evidence analysis, control testing, and audit response preparation, with a human in the loop where assurance demands it. Partner directly with engineering and architecture teams to design controls into new systems at build time and translate that technical work into the narratives auditors actually need. Partner with the Security Compliance Manager to shape and mature the global compliance program. Design, implement and validate security controls relevant to DoorDash's regulatory environment, not just document them. Support development and refinement of security policies, standards, and guidance. Mentor other members of the compliance team and help set the technical bar the rest of the function grows into. Ensure policies are actionable, testable, and aligned to real-world controls. We're excited about you because you have… 5+ years of experience in security compliance, GRC or technology risk, with a strong track record in high-growth, technology-driven and regulated environments. Hands-on experience building large language models and agent workflows with daily use of AI in your own work, grounded judgment on what to delegate to agents versus what needs a human, and the ability to evidence both to an auditor. DoorDash is an AI-forward organization and the ability to optimize efficiency using AI is crucial in this role. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with frameworks such as DORA, the EU AI Act, NIS2 and CRA. Real, hands-on experience implementing and assessing controls against frameworks like PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001 - not just reading them. Demonstrated ability to identify control gaps, assess risk and drive remediation in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. Experience developing, implementing and improving security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they are operational and effective. Strong understanding of compliance metrics and reporting, with the ability to track control effectiveness, audit outcomes, and risk exposure. Ability to influence and drive accountability across technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex audit and compliance requirements into clear, actionable guidance. Comfort owning compliance metrics and reporting - you can show, not just assert, that a program is working. Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. title: AI Platform Engineer
description: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry. Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. The role We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it. You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built. Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are. Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on. AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products. Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear. What we look for A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction. Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it. High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through. Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so. Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore. Why join You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Lead Data Engineer
description: About Better Collective Sports media at scale, running on data Better Collective is a global sports media group, reaching more than 400 million monthly visits across a portfolio of leading sports media brands. We build products and experiences that make sports more engaging and accessible for fans around the world. Behind that sits a large and diverse technology and data landscape, spanning markets, brands and business models. We work in a collaborative environment where people are encouraged to challenge how things are done, take ownership and help shape what comes next. The domain Paid media is where the data has to pay off. We spend real money across dozens of ad networks every day. Which campaigns scale, which creatives get cut, which markets get more budget: those calls come out of the models this team builds. Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue, CRM data, all stitched into one user-level view of what a click was actually worth. That model exists and it works. It is also the most demanding domain on our data platform - the most sources, the fastest schema churn, and the shortest patience for a table that landed late. We are looking for the engineer who owns it. Where this role sits A central platform team sets the how. You set the what. Better Collective runs a hub and spoke data organisation. A central data platform team owns the platform itself - MotherDuck, dbt, Dagster, DLT, the golden paths, the standards, the infrastructure. Paid Media Insights is a domain team, a spoke, that builds on it. The split is deliberate and we hold to it. The platform team decides how data is produced here. You decide what paid media produces, and you own everything we run. So you are not starting a new stack, and you are not going to spend your year on plumbing that a central team should be solving once for everyone. You are, however, expected to be a demanding customer. When a golden path does not fit paid media, we want you to say so and push for it to change, not quietly build around it. You will report to the Senior Head of Paid Media Insights and work across Paid Media, with the Campaign, Commercial and CRM teams, as well as with the central platform team. What you will own Every data job in paid media. All of it. Freshness, cost, reliability, alerting, and the incident at 07:30 before the spend review. If a paid media model is wrong or late, it is yours, not the platform team's. That accountability is the core of this role, not a footnote to it. Concretely, you will own: The end-to-end user-level model. Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue, and CRM, joined into one view the business trusts enough to move budget on. Ingestion of paid media sources, built on the platform's framework. Which sources, which schemas, and what happens the next time a network changes its API without telling anyone. The domain's models, from staging through to the marts analysts and business teams actually query, plus the semantic meaning that sits on top of them. Nobody at the centre can define what a qualified signup means in paid media. You can. Reverse ETL back into the ad platforms, so online and offline conversion data lands where it changes bidding. The handover. Part of your first year is taking over the paid media jobs the central team still runs on our behalf, and moving that ownership to where the context actually lives. What you will lead A group of engineers, and the standard they build to You will guide and mentor a group of data engineers in Paid Media Insights, as their technical lead. That means setting the standard for how this domain builds, reviewing their work, unblocking them, and deliberately growing them: giving away the interesting problems rather than keeping them. You will also shape the domain's roadmap together with the Senior Head of Paid Media Insights, the analysts and the business teams, and you will represent paid media in platform conversations, including how we support machine learning and data science on top of this data. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a step away from building. You will be in the code. What we are looking for More than a stack match, we are looking for a particular way of working. You take ownership, and it shows up in the boring parts. Plenty of engineers want to design the model. You also want the pager. You would rather own a domain end to end, unglamorous parts included, than build one piece and hand off the consequences. When things get tricky, you follow through. You break complex systems into simple parts. Paid media data is genuinely messy: attribution windows, late conversions, identity across platforms, and dozens of source APIs that all disagree. You can hold that complexity and still hand the business something they can reason about. You raise the people around you. You are the person colleagues come to for technical advice, and you enjoy that part of the job. You give feedback that lands, you review generously, and you would rather the whole team understand the pipeline than be the only one who does. You work well with a platform team. You have strong opinions about standards and you are still happy to work inside someone else's. You know the difference between a constraint worth fighting and a preference worth dropping, and you would rather help fix a shared path than fork it. You are already past prompting. AI is part of how you engineer, not something you occasionally ask questions. You have experimented with agents, tooling or AI-enabled workflows, and you have a view on what a data domain has to look like for them to be useful on top of it: documented, standardised, semantically clear. Paid media is likely where we find out first. You are close to the business. You will sit with marketers and analysts who are spending budget on what you build. You want that proximity, and you can talk about data with people who do not think in tables. You are technically deep where it counts. Production pipelines in SQL and Python, modelling and orchestration tooling such as dbt and Dagster, cloud data warehousing, and a real feel for performance, cost and reliability at scale. Experience with paid media or attribution data, or with machine learning pipelines, is a bonus rather than a requirement. Not sure you meet every single requirement? That is okay. Your unique experience might be exactly what we are looking for. Our stack What you will build on MotherDuck / DuckDB · dbt · Dagster · DLT · Python · SQL · AWS · reverse ETL and semantic layer tooling We do not expect you to have worked with all of these. If you have built production pipelines on Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift and you are curious about where we are going, that transfers. What we offer An international company in growth, and a flat structure Join a strong team where you can create value and make a real business impact, in a dynamic and creative environment with a flat organisational structure. Freedom with responsibility, ample room to grow, and the chance to take on a broad set of responsibilities. Flexible working hours supporting a healthy work-life balance, private health insurance, and office perks including lunch, snacks, gym access and social events, alongside skilled, passionate and fun colleagues. Your path to Better Collective How to apply We process applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For questions about the position, reach out to Michael Hill, Senior Head of Paid Media Insights, at ----- We look forward to hearing from you. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Privacy Counsel (m/f/d)
description: Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team. Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers. We're looking for a commercially minded privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, understanding how technology works and finding practical solutions to complex legal questions. This is a broad, hands-on role combining privacy advisory work, commercial support and the continued development of internal data protection processes. What You'll Be Doing Advise colleagues across the business on a broad range of privacy and data protection matters, providing clear, commercially focused legal guidance. Work closely with product, technology and commercial teams on the development of new services, ensuring privacy considerations are addressed early in the process. Support the negotiation of commercial agreements, particularly around data processing, international transfers, customer relationships and third-party arrangements. Advise on GDPR and other applicable international data protection regulations, helping the business understand and manage its obligations across different markets. Provide legal guidance on emerging technologies, including AI, and the implications of new products and data processing activities from a privacy perspective. Review and improve existing privacy policies, internal procedures and governance frameworks to ensure they remain practical and fit for purpose. Work alongside information security and IT teams on data governance, risk assessments and privacy-related incidents. Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of privacy operations, including through automation and better internal processes. Monitor regulatory developments affecting technology businesses, particularly around data protection, AI and digital services. Provide training and guidance to colleagues across the organisation, helping non-legal teams understand their responsibilities when handling personal data. What They're Looking For A qualified lawyer with approximately 4-10 years experience specialising in data protection, privacy or technology law, gained in private practice, in-house or a combination of both. Strong knowledge of GDPR and European data protection law, including regulatory guidance and its practical application within commercial organisations. Experience advising technology businesses, ideally with exposure to software, AI, digital products or other data-intensive environments. A good understanding of artificial intelligence technologies and the legal and regulatory challenges associated with their development and use. Experience advising on commercial agreements involving personal data, international transfers and complex data processing arrangements. Comfortable working directly with product, engineering and technical stakeholders, with the ability to understand complex issues and provide clear, practical legal advice. A commercial approach to risk management, recognising that the role of legal is to help the business find workable solutions rather than simply identify problems. Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently. Experience working within an international business or advising on privacy matters across multiple jurisdictions would be beneficial. Why Consider This Opportunity? This is an opportunity to join an international technology business where privacy plays an important role in how the company operates, develops its products and works with customers. You'll have a broad remit, working closely with different teams across the organisation on a range of commercial, operational and regulatory matters, including some of the challenges emerging technologies bring to data protection. If you're a privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, has an interest in technology and takes a practical approach to solving legal challenges, we'd be interested in hearing from you. description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it. What you’ll be doing Lead delivery across the projects in our Strategic pod, holding commercials to plan and surfacing risks early. Lead and develop the people who report to you, so they progress. Spot where a project can grow, and bring cross-sell and upsell opportunities to the account team. Lead internal projects that change how the pod delivers, and feed them into our shared delivery framework. Shape how AI is used in our delivery workflows, beyond your own work. Led people, through line management or equivalent, and be able to point to someone who progressed. Changed how a team works and be able to show it was adopted. Built or shaped AI-enabled workflows, and be able to explain what you learned. You’re unlikely to thrive here if You prefer to direct work from a distance, rather than stay close enough to the detail to make sound commercial and delivery calls. You’re more comfortable following an established playbook than building one as the team and the product evolve. You see leadership as managing tasks rather than developing people and holding them to a high standard. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold . Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno . Private healthcare insurance through AXA . Income protection and Life Insurance. Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry. Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><h3><strong>About The Team</strong></h3> <p>The Roku Enterprise Engineering team is at the forefront of building a robust, integrated, and scalable platform that powers critical business processes across the organization. As a cornerstone of Roku's corporate strategy, this team is instrumental in automating workflows across all Business Systems, including Supply Chain, Finance, Sales Operations, and Human Resources. By challenging traditional approaches to workflow automation, the team leverages cutting-edge Engineering practices and API-driven design to streamline internal processes, boost efficiency, and deliver innovative solutions.</p> <p>The team's expertise spans a wide range of technologies, including Java and Python-based MicroServices, AWS/GCP cloud backend systems, Big Data technologies like Hive and Spark, and modern Web applications. With a globally distributed presence across the US, India and Europe, the team thrives on collaboration, bringing together diverse perspectives to solve complex challenges. At the heart of their success is a shared commitment to technical excellence, creativity, a strong sense of ownership, and a collaborative spirit that drives impactful results for Roku's business operations.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>About The Role</strong></h3> <p>As a senior technical lead, you consider yourself a platform services developer and developing innovative solutions using modern software frameworks and paradigms. You are self-driven and problem solver, with a strong background in building large-scale software platform and applications. You are execution focused and would develop a reputation for repeatedly delivering projects on-time.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design, develop and deploy scalable web applications and services, being part of everything from contributing to web technology and framework stack, to use case and data model design</li> <li>Drive architecture discussions, take ownership and responsibility over new projects, and deliver high quality software with tight timeline</li> <li>Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure the application meets compliance, security and audit requirements</li> <li>Participate in the continual improvement of engineering tools, cloud-based technologies/services, and process</li> <li>Define and participate in Agile development process, including scoping, technical design, estimation effort, coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, maintenance and support</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-function teams and demonstrate great communication skills</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>We're excited if you have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in delivery multi-tier, highly scalable, distributed web application</li> <li>Deep understanding in software architecture, object-oriented design principles, and data structures</li> <li>Extensive experience in developing microservices using Java, Python</li> <li>Good experience in Test driven development and automating test cases using Java/ Python</li> <li>Experience in SQL / NoSQL (Oracle, Cassandra) database design</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to be proactive, self-driven, and make practical trade-offs based on business needs, entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>BS or MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent</li> <li>Experience in distributed computing frameworks like - Hive/Hadoop, Apache Spark</li> <li>Experience in developing Finance or HR related applications</li> <li>Experience with following cloud services: AWS Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC, Elastic Cache, Lambda</li> <li>Working experience with Terraform</li> <li>Experience in creating workflows for Apache Airflow</li> </ul> <h6>#LI-GL1</h6><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice.
